question: Approve this ADR 0005 amendment draft into implementation? Approving also confirms the relayed words 「注意應該是建議守則不是強迫性的，直到我們設計一個 skill 讓獨立的 agent 做這件事，且可以確保完全保密完全不外洩」 as yours; say if you object.

artifacts.summary: Docs only. ADR 0005 is amended in place (as ADR 0002 and 0004 were): four recommended naming rules for a person laying out a vault, each with its reason; the guidance authorizes no agent to create, rename or edit a vault or item; agent layout waits for a dedicated skill run by an independent agent with no secret exposure. Consequences gain three facts verified 2026-10-23 (empty password field creation, case-insensitive references, a vault rename breaks name-based mappings). adr_lint --require 5 exits 0 on a temp copy. Residual: the ADR title still says an agent lays out items, now described as the unbuilt target.
